feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
entry.summary: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

entry.title: 'Disturbed' by Cornell rape investigation, NY governor puts state AG in charge
entry.summary: The Cornell University Police Department is leading the investigation into an alleged gang rape two years ago. How effective is that approach, and is the campus police accountable to the public?

entry.title: Talk of drones and a burning flame on Trump's D.C. arch worries aviation experts
entry.summary: Aviation safety experts were wary of Trump's proposed arch near D.C.'s airport. Then came the FAA's unusual lighting recommendations — including an eternal flame on top — and Trump's talk of drones.

entry.title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
entry.summary: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.

entry.title: Who uttered the phrase 'the ideological clowns are out' this week? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus, how well do you know your pandas and fat bears?

entry.title: After bankruptcy, he was banned from sports betting sites. Then he discovered Kalshi
entry.summary: The dark side of the prediction market boom is becoming more clear: Experts say the sites have become go-to outlets for gambling addicts to relapse as the companies avoid state consumer protections.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: September jobs report to give an update on the market, Tennessee governor halts executions after woman survives attempt, N.Y. attorney general appointed as special prosecutor in Cornell rape case.

entry.title: Car crimes in San Francisco have dropped. The city says Flock cameras have helped
entry.summary: Car crimes have plunged in San Francisco over the last four years. The city credits, in part, Flock cameras. We investigate the claim.

entry.title: Some school districts switch to electric buses as diesel prices soar
entry.summary: School districts that drive long distances are navigating record high diesel prices in different ways. Some have transitioned to electric or propane buses to ease the pinch.

entry.title: Christa Pike's lawyer on her botched execution and the state's investigation into it
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks Randy Spivey, a lawyer representing a death row inmate who survived two lethal injections, about Tennessee's handling of executions.
